unverified.reportedText: MappedTokenAdapter Start/Invoke exception; failed to resolve path; InvokeAdapterMethod failures
unverified.reason: Start/Invoke catches and final warning combine setup, graph and concrete failures. Invoke(object Path) and InvokeAdapterMethod lack a declared Activity and cannot be assigned the catalog Get selector.
unverified.neededEvidence: Redacted exact overload/call site, source stage and canonical activity before a route.

unverified.reportedText: MappedAdapter is null; No valid path parts; Invocation failed for path
unverified.reason: Canonical mapped Get passes $this, so null-MappedAdapter is an unproven direct path. String -split produces a part after nonblank validation. Invocation-failed warning follows any child failure/no-Result, without diagnosis.
unverified.neededEvidence: Current direct helper call provenance or redacted child failure site and selected path state.

unverified.reportedText: Token concrete Construct/Invoke exception or path failed to resolve
unverified.reason: Ten concrete wrappers span helper, Signal, graph and provider exceptions and inherited child failure/no-Result; their labels cannot identify the underlying guard. Several emit stale EmbeddedFileSystem labels only at the fixed null-dictionary guard already routed per concrete.
unverified.neededEvidence: Redacted concrete/helper source stage and exact failing condition, not wrapper text alone.

unverified.reportedText: Resolve-DynamicPath exception including path and child message
unverified.reason: Dynamic resolver contains many fixed and variable throws assembled into an outer path-plus-exception catch. The catch has multiple variable segments and broad failure sources; v1 prefix-suffix alone would collide. No path/value content is retained.
unverified.neededEvidence: Structured redacted function/argument guard and throw/catch attribution; no expression/value text or runtime provider effect.

unverified.reason: Formatter FilePath/Json/String/VirtualFolder helper catches cover varied conversion and path failures. Handler-missing guard is routed, child failure warning is not a diagnosis.
unverified.neededEvidence: Redacted selected handler, exact child source guard and no path/content.

unverified.reportedText: MappedAdapter failed to resolve key <key> with scope <scope>; storage child exception
unverified.reason: Two dynamic key/scope fields cannot be bound with one v1 prefix-suffix; failure comes from nested mapped Storage Invoke. No nested read/write result or retry is inferred.
unverified.neededEvidence: Canonical nested owner/activity and structured child Failure/source guard with redacted key/scope.

unverified.reportedText: Conduction/Generator/Navigator variable missing or helper exception
unverified.reason: Current helpers call [System.Conduction], [System.Generator] and [System.Navigator] static lookups under catches; direct runtime type support and missing-value reachability are unverified. Class constructor null guards remain routed.
unverified.neededEvidence: Current type registration and redacted scope/key result state or exact caught exception site.

unverified.reportedText: Memory empty inner path or missing descendant Result
unverified.reason: Empty inner path invokes misspelled $opSlignal.SetResult and catches technical failure; nonnull dictionary may return without Result. Neither broad exception nor no-Result alone identifies an approved correction. Null dictionary warning is separately routed.
unverified.neededEvidence: Redacted selected scope, inner path-empty, dictionary null and child resolver flags.

unverified.reportedText: SDA enrollment/ID/RefTag/OCIID helper throws and Token_Formatter.Invoke wrapper
unverified.reason: Active Token_SDA module forwards to Invoke-TokenSDA and many process helpers that can mutate ItemSignal or write storage. Fixed top-level path/handler guards are routed; lower-level throws need exact dispatch and effect-state attribution before safe recipes.
unverified.neededEvidence: Redacted selected SDA handler/operation, exact child source guard and effect ledger; no artifact or secret content.

unverified.reason: Current Token_SDA.psm1 defines the active class and imports Invoke-TokenSDA; separate Token_SDA.ps1 is not dot-sourced by this module.
unverified.neededEvidence: Versioned load/call provenance for the separate class before claiming its errors are current mapped Get output.
